approvalEvidenceMeaning: none means no per-question academic approval record is stored here. It does not mean the question was judged wrong, and it must not be used to disable the existing bank.
fingerprint: sha256 of JSON {format,prompt,stimulus,options,answer,taskLabel,taskInstruction}. Status, preview and formalField are stored separately and are not part of this hash. feedbackSha256 is also separate.
